text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"You can follow in the trail I blaze, but 
I won't guide you"— that Sirius Symboli 
was beginning to change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Symboli Rudolf, who had been 
working behind the scenes, followed her 
heart and pleaded with Sirius Symboli, 
saying, "I want to run with you one more 
time."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both undergoing their own transformations, 
the two were set to clash on the grand 
stage of the Arima Kinen.
